sheet.name: Ratwolves

traits.name: Strength of the Pack
traits.text:
A Ratwolf’s Toughness value, shown directly above the AT value, indicates how many times it can survive a Knight Attack that would otherwise be deadly. When you are about to wound a BP card, if the number of Generic tokens on it is equal to its Toughness value, you simply deal a Wound and the Ratwolf dies. Otherwise, instead of dealing a Wound, place a Generic token on this BP card and leave it revealed on the Mob track, then resolve Responses as if you dealt a Wound.

When a Ratwolf dies, finish resolving the current action, then Spawn a new Ratwolf with a BP of one Level higher. If there are no valid BP cards, Spawn a Ratwolf of the same BP Level or lower (prioritizing higher Levels). New Ratwolves Spawn adjacent to a random Knight, on a space closest to the Board Edge and without an Obstacle. If that space is occupied by another miniature, Displace it. Then, the spawned Ratwolf performs Signature.

traits.name: Rising Pressure
traits.text: When a Knight gains Condition tokens, they gain that much [H].

traits.name: Go for the Weakest Link
traits.text:
After resolving all other Attack Consequences:
• If you are knocked down, Afflict 1.
• If you are a Lone Knight, Afflict 1.

traits.name: Relentless Pull
traits.text: Increase each Drag performed by Ratwolves by 1 for every Condition token on the Target.

traits.name: Into the Chittering Shadows
traits.text: Ratwolves always perform Drag toward the closest short Board Edge.

traits.name: Kinderfänger
traits.text: At the end of a Drag performed by a Ratwolf, if you are a Lone Knight, suffer Knockdown.

traits.name: Adaptability
traits.text: This Trait changes depending on the Kingdom. Refer to the Kingdom Trait.

traits.name: Ravening Ratswarm
traits.text: During a Drag performed by a Ratwolf, if it would cause that Ratwolf to move past a short Board Edge, the Target dies. Place the Ratwolf adjacent to a random Knight on a space closest to a short Board Edge and without an Obstacle. If that space is occupied by another miniature, Displace it.

traits.name: Rat King
traits.text: Knights cannot discard Condition cards with Condition tokens, or discard any tokens from those cards, unless adjacent to another Knight.

clashSetup.page: Sunken Kingdom / Principality of Stone Codex p.36–37 (same diagram in both)
steps: Monster Positioning: Put numbered base rings on all Ratwolf miniatures. Randomly place Ratwolf miniatures numbered 1–4 on the spaces designated on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrows. Then, place 4 BP 1 cards face down in a random order on spaces 1–4 on the Mob track.

Additional Setup: Depending on the Kingdom, take the Parasite Bed (Principality of Stone) or Bile and Poison (Sunken Kingdom) Trait card. Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).
